# Feather icons

Feather v4.29.2, https://github.com/feathericons/feather/tree/v4.29.2, MIT (Cole Bemis). Assets use canonical upstream SVG paths.

SVG currentColor is normalized to black for native template tinting; paths are otherwise unchanged. Original vector SVGs are compiled by Apple asset catalog tools, no raster conversion or runtime downloads. License is included in the app bundle.
